ui_viewport_t(3) Library Functions Manual ui_viewport_t(3)

NAME

ui_viewport_t

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/ui/viewport.h>

Data Fields


size_t selected
size_t first_visible
size_t page_size

Detailed Description

Selection is an absolute item index; first_visible is relative to its page. A zero page_size means one page containing the complete data set.
